def clean(df):
    df = df.copy()
    # remove exact duplicate rows
    df = df.drop_duplicates().reset_index(drop=True)
    # fix species case variants
    df['species'] = df['species'].astype(str).str.strip().str.title()
    # fix island typos / variants
    island_map = {'Bisco': 'Biscoe', 'Dram': 'Dream'}
    df['island'] = df['island'].astype(str).str.strip().replace(island_map)
    # numeric columns stored as text -> numbers
    for col in ['flipper_length_mm', 'body_mass_g', 'year']:
        df[col] = pd.to_numeric(df[col], errors='coerce')
    # out-of-range flipper lengths -> NaN
    df.loc[(df['flipper_length_mm'] < 170) | (df['flipper_length_mm'] > 235), 'flipper_length_mm'] = pd.NA
    return df

def answer(df):
    d = df.dropna(subset=['island'])
    counts = d.groupby('island').size()
    return {str(k): int(v) for k, v in counts.items()}
